health.title: Overall health
health.hint: Worst-of delivery status across workstreams and critical milestones. The four status dimensions and the gate blockers are shown separately and are never averaged into it.

gate.noGates: No business gates are defined for this project.
gate.allApproved: Every gate is approved: no gate blockers.

decisions.hint: Open decisions ranked by latest safe decision date (overdue first, undated last), and the blockers of the next gate.
decisions.empty: No open decisions that you can see.

asks.hint: Decision papers awaiting the committee and agenda requests awaiting secretariat screening.
asks.awaitingEmpty: No decision papers are awaiting the committee.
asks.agendaEmpty: No agenda requests are awaiting screening.

setupWizard.subtitle: The setup steps of the project (spec §21). Steps 5 and 6 are done here; the others open the screen where they are done today.
setupWizard.neverApproves: The setup records drafts and proposals only. Nothing is approved here: charters, delegations of authority and baselines are approved by the authorized people on the Committee Hub and the Integrated Plan.

steps.settings: Confidentiality, retention, integrations and AI mode
steps.launch: Launch monitoring with the gap list

committee.title: Step 5 — Committee, delegation and quorum
committee.hint: Choose or create the committee, then load its delegation of authority with the quorum and voting rules. They are saved as a draft that is not in force until approved.
committee.chooseHint: Program committee, NewCo board and JV board are kept distinct.
committee.askSecretariat: The committee secretariat creates the committee.
committee.createEffect: The committee starts as a Draft: its charter is approved and the committee activated on the Committee Hub.
committee.manageSeats: Manage seats on the Committee Hub
committee.charterInHub: The charter is drafted and approved, and the committee activated, on the Committee Hub.
committee.delegationBlockHint: Quorum, approval threshold and tie rule, plus the delegation table (decision types, limits and escalation). Validated with the same rules the server applies.
committee.dissolved: This committee is dissolved: no new delegation can be loaded.
committee.cannotLoad: Your role cannot load a delegation of authority.
committee.minPercent: Minimum share of voting members present (%)
committee.invariants: Always applied (not configurable): nobody approves their own request, and recused members do not count towards the quorum.
committee.delegationHint: An array of decision types: key, name (en and ar), maxAmount (or null), currency, unitScale, withinCommitteeAuthority and escalateTo. A whole authority policy file is also accepted.
committee.fileShape: The file holds neither a list of decision types nor an authority policy.
committee.invalidPolicy: The delegation is not valid yet:
committee.saveEffect: Version {version} of the delegation of authority of {name} is saved as a Draft.
committee.pendingEffect: It is not in force: an authorized approver approves it on the Committee Hub with the approval document, and a second person verifies that document.
committee.pendingEffectDemo: It is not in force: an authorized approver approves it on the Committee Hub.
committee.noApproval: This wizard does not approve it.
committee.saved: Delegation saved as a draft, pending approval.
committee.versionsHint: Every version with its state. Approvals are recorded on the Committee Hub.

baseline.title: Step 6 — Baseline and gates
baseline.hint: Propose the plan's first baseline and review the business gates. The baseline is approved by an authorized approver on the Integrated Plan, not here.
baseline.baselineHint: A baseline freezes the confirmed plan (tasks that are not Draft or cancelled, and the milestones) as the reference for variance.
baseline.preview: The baseline would freeze {tasks} confirmed tasks and {milestones} milestones.
baseline.nothing: Nothing to baseline yet: confirm the plan's activities first.
baseline.cannotPropose: Your role cannot propose a baseline; the project manager does.
baseline.proposeEffect: Baseline version {version} is created from the current plan ({tasks} tasks, {milestones} milestones) and proposed for approval.
baseline.notApproved: It is not approved and not the reference until an authorized approver approves it on the Integrated Plan. This wizard does not approve it.
baseline.pending: Proposed on {date} by {name}; an authorized approver approves or rejects it on the Integrated Plan.
baseline.rebaseline: A baseline is already approved: a new one needs an approved change request (re-baselining).
baseline.gatesHint: The gates of the template with their current status, approver role and open blockers. Criteria and approvals are handled on the gates screen.
